attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 14
attributes.name: Lab Accident
attributes.powers: Display this card when you encounter a monster. While displayed, for your combat check, you may recharge any number of boons that have the Alchemical trait to use your Arcane or Divine skill; for each boon recharged, add 1d8+1 and the Acid, Electricity, Fire, or Poison trait. If you fail a combat check against a monster, it is undefeated and deals no damage.
attributes.recharge: At the end of the encounter, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 16 check to display or recharge it instead.
